name: harness-talk
description: The King James Bible, addressed for machines. One command: loopback daemon, MCP server and typed clients for the harness.talk corpus.

scripts.check: node bin/harness-talk.mjs help >/dev/null && node -e "import('./client/index.mjs').then(m=>{if(typeof m.createClient!=='function')process.exit(1)})" && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release: npm run check && npm version patch && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm run check && npm version minor && npm publish --access public
